ProduDash internal alpha media-tool notice
==========================================

Approval reference
------------------

OWNER-DIRECTIVE-2026-07-26-PRODUDASH-ALPHA1

This bundle was approved by the ProduDash owner for the private
0.1.0-alpha.1 macOS arm64 prerelease. It is not an approval to publish the
application or its bundled media tools publicly.

FFmpeg
------

Version: 8.1.2
Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz
Signature: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz.asc
Release-key fingerprint: FCF986EA15E6E293A5644F10B4322F04D67658D8
Signature verification: successful
Source modifications: none

x264
----

Commit: b35605ace3ddf7c1a5d67a2eb553f034aef41d55
Source: https://code.videolan.org/videolan/x264/-/commit/b35605ace3ddf7c1a5d67a2eb553f034aef41d55
Source modifications: none

Build
-----

Target: macOS arm64
Compiler: Apple clang
FFmpeg license reported by the built binaries: GPL version 2 or later
Nonfree components: disabled

x264 configuration:

  ./configure --enable-static --disable-cli --disable-opencl

FFmpeg configuration:

  ./configure --disable-debug --disable-doc --disable-ffplay
  --disable-network --disable-autodetect --enable-static --disable-shared
  --enable-gpl --enable-libx264

The x264 library was linked statically so ProduDash retains its existing
H.264/AAC render behavior. The resulting ffmpeg and ffprobe programs are
separate executables launched by ProduDash.

License
-------

This bundle contains FFmpeg and x264 under GPL-2.0-or-later. The complete
GPL version 2 license text is included as NOTICE-GPL-2.0.txt. Copyrights
remain with their respective authors. These programs are provided without
warranty.

For any distribution beyond this private internal alpha, retain this
notice and the license text, make the exact corresponding FFmpeg 8.1.2 and
x264 source available with the distributed binaries, and complete the
owner's release compliance review.
